version.changelog: Added test suite with 7 tests. Fixed registry metadata to declare required credentials (GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_USERNAME).

llm.summary: The skill's code, runtime instructions, and required credentials align with a GitHub integration: it asks only for a GitHub token/username and uses the GitHub API for the described features.

dimensions.detail: The skill name, description, SKILL.md, and code all implement GitHub actions (list repos, get repo, check CI, create issues, search, recent commits). Required env vars and config keys (GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_USERNAME / github.token, github.username) directly map to this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the user to provide a GitHub PAT (with recommended scopes) via env vars or OpenClaw config and to restart the gateway. The runtime instructions and the code access only GitHub API endpoints and the declared config/env; they do not read unrelated system files or exfiltrate data to other endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install script or external downloads are declared (instruction-only plus included JS files). The package contains only the skill implementation and a test file; nothing is fetched from arbitrary URLs during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires a GitHub PAT and username, which is appropriate. The SKILL.md recommends the 'repo' scope for private repo operations — that scope is broad but justified if you want private-repo management and issue creation; for public-only usage the user can grant 'public_repo'. Users should apply least privilege when creating the token.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide settings. It reads credentials only from declared env vars or the declared OpenClaw config path.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent with its GitHub-management purpose, but before installing: 1) Provide a GitHub Personal Access Token with the minimal scopes you need (use public_repo for public-only, repo for private + issue creation). 2) Treat the token as sensitive — store it in a secrets manager or the OpenClaw config, and rotate/revoke it if you stop trusting the skill. 3) The included code matches the documentation and only calls api.github.com; you can review index.js to confirm behavior (create_issue allows an extra object to be passed through, which is expected for issue fields). 4) The package source/homepage is not provided in the registry metadata; if you need stronger assurance, ask the publisher for a source repo or run the included test.js locally with a throwaway token first. 5) If you only need read-only data, grant the narrowest scopes possible. Overall: functionally consistent and proportionate, but only install if you trust the skill author or have reviewed the code.
